en.sayed-ali-raza: Stick to the earth, keep patient in trials,
do not move your hands and swords after the liking of your tongues,
and do not make haste in matters in which Allāh has not asked for haste,
because any one of you who dies in his bed while he had knowledge of the rights of Allāh and the rights of His Prophet and members of the Prophet’s house, will die as a martyr.
His reward is incumbent on Allāh.
He is also eligible to the recompense of what good acts he has intended to do,
since his intention takes the place of drawing his sword.
Certainly, for every thing there is a time and a limit.
